# Legacy Word fixtures / 旧版 Word 夹具

These are original binary MS-DOC documents in actual MS-CFB containers, generated by `generate.py` using only the Python standard library. No private document, Microsoft Office, downloaded content or conversion runtime is required.

这些夹具为原创的真实 MS-CFB 容器和 MS-DOC 二进制结构，由 Python 标准库生成，不含私人文档或下载内容，不要求 Office 或转换运行时。

The positive file contains a Word 97 FIB, a CLX with Prc and Pcdt, a compressed English piece, UTF-16 Chinese and emoji pieces, cached field text, table cell delimiters and seven declared story ranges. Physical stream order differs from logical CP order. Unreferenced old body text is present but must not be indexed. Other files deliberately set encryption, an unsupported Word 95 generation, descending CP boundaries or an invalid surrogate.

正例包含 Word 97 FIB、具有 Prc/Pcdt 的 CLX、八位压缩英文、UTF-16 中文和表情、保存的域结果、表格单元分隔与七类故事。物理流顺序不同于 CP 逻辑顺序，未引用的旧正文必须被排除。负例分别为加密、Word 95、逆序 CP 和损坏代理项。

This is a format-contract fixture, not a claim of Word-perfect layout rendering. The parser explicitly reports unimplemented layout, image, field execution and formatting/revision display features.

这是格式合同夹具，不表示版式渲染与 Word 完全一致；解析器明确报告未解析的版式、图像、域执行以及格式/修订显示策略。

Primary format references: [MS-DOC FIB](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/office_file_formats/ms-doc/9aeaa2e7-4a45-468e-ab13-3f6193eb9394), [PlcPcd](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/office_file_formats/ms-doc/1caae71f-35c4-49d7-adf0-af5fc766331c), [FcCompressed](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/office_file_formats/ms-doc/aa2e55a2-f4f2-4795-bab5-6d9d7a0ed249).

## Independent producer files / 独立生产者原件

Two unmodified Apache POI files from the fixed `REL_5_4_1` tag supplement the authored structural cases. Their upstream `TestWordExtractor` asserts the Euro-symbol header, Molière footer, TestFootnote, TestEndnote and TestComment that our regression also verifies. Original license and notice text are retained as `APACHE-LICENSE.txt` and `APACHE-NOTICE.txt`; the fixture generator does not modify these files.

另外保留 Apache POI 固定标签 `REL_5_4_1` 下两个未修改原件；其原测试的欧元页眉、Molière 页脚、脚注、尾注与批注断言作为独立对照。原许可证与通知随夹具保留，生成器不会覆盖这些原件。

- `poi-HeaderFooterUnicode.doc`: 28,672 bytes; SHA-256 `8bd7fc9552bccb7b71a0dc34ffd801e7d3547d1317fd75d0c35fca3572f6fa4b`; [original](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apache/poi/REL_5_4_1/test-data/document/HeaderFooterUnicode.doc)
- `poi-footnote.doc`: 9,728 bytes; SHA-256 `81a18ac63010789ca08c28de107658a308c758a3cfc667a6edf11ffe888d3e13`; [original](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apache/poi/REL_5_4_1/test-data/document/footnote.doc)
- [Upstream oracle](https://github.com/apache/poi/blob/REL_5_4_1/poi-scratchpad/src/test/java/org/apache/poi/hwpf/extractor/TestWordExtractor.java)
